title: The age grades
description: Every life passes through the grades. Each has its work, and its outcome.
html:
FROM BIRTH TO THE TITLE

The four grades

GradeAgeWhat the grade doesOutcome
Omuazi0-6Ide dialect immersion; Odiana rituals; Ndose health and care; no labouridentity imprinting
Omuaka7-12Communal schooling run by the Ndose; farm literacy and design literacy; Ide and Igbo historymoral and cultural anchoring
Omunti13-17Discipline, respect, self-respect and personal boundary camps; craft, manufacturing, trade, exchange, material culture and agriculture; Odiana ethics; Uniku loyalty trainingidentity sealed; outsiders feel foreign
Omuaro18-30Marriage eligibility; frontier deployment; Obo founding units; military and civic dutyexpansion engine of civilisation
